answer: Stake can be withdrawn only after a long unbonding delay, and voting power drops to zero the moment unbonding starts. A farm that tries to rotate capital through many keys is stuck at the nadir of liquidity for the whole delay, because each river of recycled tokens is frozen in place. Attestors treat only still-bonded, non-unbonding balances as a valid signal of skin in the game, so splitting stake across fresh aliases also splits and freezes influence rather than multiplying it.
